exercises.question: Which sentence combines a past-present contrast with change?
options: En comparación con antes, la vida ha cambiado mucho. [Compared with before, life has changed a lot.]
La vida es grande y tiene muchas cosas buenas. [Life is big and has many good things.]
La vida será muy diferente en el futuro cercano. [Life will be very different in the near future.]

exercises.sentence: Con los años, mi hermana __ profesora.
exercises.english: Over the years, my sister became a teacher.
It is necessary for young people to adapt.

sentences: Antes la comunicación era más lenta. [Before, communication was slower.]
Actualmente es más rápida. [Currently it is faster.]
En comparación con antes, actualmente es más rápida. [Compared with before, it is currently faster.]

exercises.question: Which sentence makes a future prediction?
options: Probablemente seguirá evolucionando. [It will probably continue evolving.]
Antes evolucionaba muy despacio. [It used to evolve very slowly.]
Actualmente evoluciona muy rápido. [It currently evolves very fast.]

exercises.english: It is important that we improve things.

exercises.question: Which sentence puts change, prediction and evaluation together?
options: El mundo ha cambiado, probablemente seguirá cambiando y es necesario que nos adaptemos. [The world has changed, it will probably continue changing and it is necessary for us to adapt.]
Vivimos en un mundo muy grande donde la tecnología es importante para todos. [We live in a very big world where technology is important for everyone.]
El trabajo de mi padre cambió mucho en los últimos años, como todo el mundo sabe. [My father's work changed a lot in recent years, as everyone knows.]

exercises.sentence: Antes, muchas personas vivían en comunidades pequeñas.
options: Before, many people lived in small communities.
Currently, everyone lives in small communities.
In the future, people will live in small communities.

exercises.sentence: Es importante que la sociedad se adapte.
options: It is important for society to adapt.
Society has adapted to all the changes.
It is not important for society to change.

exercises.sentence: Probablemente habrá más oportunidades en el futuro.
exercises.english: There will probably be more opportunities in the future.

options: En comparación con antes, ha cambiado mucho. [Compared with before, it has changed a lot.]
En comparación que antes, ha cambiado mucho. [Compared than before, it has changed a lot.]
No ha cambiado porque ha cambiado. [It has not changed because it has changed.]
Es necesario que nos adaptemos. [It is necessary for us to adapt.]
Es necesario que nos adaptamos. [It is necessary for us to adapt.]
Es necesario que adaptábamos. [It is necessary that we used to adapt.]
Puede traer desafíos y oportunidades. [It can bring challenges and opportunities.]
Puede que trae desafíos y oportunidades. [It may bring (indicative) challenges and opportunities.]
No puede traer nada. [It cannot bring anything.]

exercises.question: Which answer gives a complete evaluation of change?
options: El cambio presenta desafíos, pero también oportunidades; por eso es importante adaptarse. [Change presents challenges, but also opportunities; therefore it is important to adapt.]
Todo cambio requiere tiempo y paciencia porque cambiar los hábitos es difícil. [Every change requires time and patience because changing habits is hard.]
Un cambio importante traerá nuevas transformaciones en el futuro. [An important change will bring new transformations in the future.]

template.prompt: Describe a past-present change and predict what may happen next.
template.answer: Antes la situación era diferente, pero actualmente ha cambiado mucho. Probablemente seguirá evolucionando.

template.prompt: Evaluate a development and state what needs to change.
template.answer: El desarrollo ofrece oportunidades, pero también presenta desafíos. Es necesario que mejoremos algunas cosas.
